text: Julia's dad had a fall on Sunday and fractured his wrist. She's driving up to Leeds tomorrow morning to stay with him for a few days.
Femi flies to Lagos on Thursday at 6pm for his cousin's wedding. Long flight, and he hates flying. Text him good luck the day before.
Aiko and Hiroshi are off to Hokkaido for two weeks in February. They go skiing every year apparently. Hiroshi said their son Louis will be staying with his grandparents.
Krisztina's little girl has chickenpox, so she's off work until at least Wednesday. Remind me to drop some soup round tomorrow afternoon.

Chatted to Rana after yoga. Her mum is having a hip replacement on the 12th at half 9. Rana is taking the week off to look after her afterwards and sounds pretty worn out already, because her dad isn't well enough to help and her brother Hamza is stuck in Dubai for work until the 20th. I should offer to sit with her mum one afternoon that week so Rana can get a break.

Chris got back from Peru last night. He did the Inca Trail and loved it, though he picked up a stomach bug on the last day. He's still a bit wiped out and has a GP appointment on Monday at 8:30 to get it checked. His girlfriend Zoe went with him and wants to do Patagonia next year, which he's less keen on. Ask how he's feeling at the weekend.
Aisha's brother Hamza broke his leg playing football on Saturday. He has surgery Monday morning and she's going to the hospital with their mum afterwards.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Lindiwe moved to Cape Town in the summer and is loving it. She works remotely for a design agency now.
Jack's trip to Vietnam is off. His passport didn't arrive in time, so he's spending the fortnight at his parents' place in Cornwall instead.
Leon has his driving test on Friday at 3pm and he is properly nervous about it. I should message him that morning to wish him luck, then call the next day to see how it went.
Gabriel and his wife Salma are celebrating their tenth anniversary in Lisbon next month. He mentioned she's been wanting a nice leather travel bag, which could be a good gift idea from all of us.
Mehmet's father has been in hospital since last Tuesday with pneumonia. Mehmet is flying out to Izmir on Saturday morning to be with the family. Don't forget to text him once he lands.
Zoe has a sausage dog called Biscuit who's just had an operation on his back. She's been sleeping on the sofa downstairs so he doesn't try the stairs.
Nasser said his daughter starts nursery next Monday. He and Divya are both a bit emotional about it.
Damian Smith from the running club is training for the Berlin marathon in September. He's aiming for under three and a half hours.

Quick one: Deepa's birthday is on the 3rd. She's into pottery, so maybe a voucher for a class at that studio in Hackney. Her husband Damian said she's also been eyeing up a new set of glazes. We're doing dinner the night before at the Turkish place on Green Lanes, 7:30.

Mihai has a job interview in Munich on Tuesday at 11am. He's flying out Monday evening and coming back the day after. It's for a senior engineering role at an automotive firm, and if he gets it the whole family would relocate in the spring. His wife Deepa is nervous about leaving her parents, who are both getting older. Must ask him how it went on Wednesday.

Ethan's grandad passed away over the weekend. The funeral is in Galway on Friday. He seemed okay on the phone but quieter than usual. I should check in on him a week after the funeral, once things settle down.
Louis and Connor are moving to Bristol at the end of November. Connor has a new job at the hospital there starting on the 1st of December.

Tendai's son has been off school all week with a high temperature. The GP thinks it's a virus. She's got him an appointment tomorrow at 10 just to be safe. Meanwhile her husband has had to cancel his work trip to Nairobi to help at home, and her mother-in-law has gone down with the same thing. She laughed about it but sounded tired. Don't forget to message her tomorrow afternoon after the appointment.
Lucy said her mum's scan results came back clear. Huge relief for the whole family after months of worrying.
Rin is going to Seoul for a month in January to visit her grandmother. She leaves on the 8th, flying via Helsinki.
Delroy injured his shoulder at the gym and can't drive for six weeks. Offer him a lift to physio on Thursday morning.
Felix is obsessed with vintage film cameras at the moment. He has about twenty of them and keeps buying more at car boot sales.

Spent an hour with Julia and Krisztina this evening. Julia is flying to Sydney on the 14th for her sister's wedding; it's a 22-hour journey with a stopover in Singapore and she's dreading it. Krisztina offered to feed her cat Pickles while she's away. Krisztina also mentioned that her own husband is going in for knee surgery the week after, so she'll have her hands full. Must remember to ask Julia about the wedding when she's back, and send Krisztina a message the day of the surgery.
Femi's wife Lindiwe is pregnant with their second, due in March. Their eldest, Ethan, is apparently very excited to be a big brother.
Aisha is sitting her final accountancy exam on the 21st at 2pm. She has barely slept this week and is really stressed about it.
Chris's mum is coming over from Toronto for Christmas. She's staying with them for three weeks, from the 18th until after New Year.
Remind me to send Rana the name of that physio in Clapham before Monday.

Hiroshi mentioned that Aiko's father is unwell back in Osaka. She's flying home tomorrow night and isn't sure when she'll be back. Their two kids are staying here with Hiroshi, and he's taking time off work to do the school runs. He admitted he's never managed packed lunches on his own before. I need to ask Hiroshi if there is anything we can do for him and the kids while she's away.
Joanna's partner Ethan proposed in Santorini last week! She showed me the ring. Wedding probably next summer.
Booked my flights to Marrakesh for the 9th of April. Leaving Gatwick at 7am, so I'll get a taxi the night before and stay at the airport hotel.

Leon passed his driving test! First time, too. He's already planning a road trip to the Lake District with his girlfriend Aisha over half term, which is brave considering he stalled four times on his last lesson. His mum is lending them her Fiesta, as long as he's back by Sunday evening. Text him congratulations tonight.
Phoned Salma about her son Jack. He came off his bike on Wednesday and needed six stitches in his chin. He's fine, but she was shaken. I'll pop round with some comics for him on Saturday.
Mehmet runs a small bakery in Walthamstow with his brother. Their simit is the best I've had outside Turkey.
Zoe's niece is in hospital with appendicitis. Operation went well this morning and she should be home the day after tomorrow.
Divya and Nasser have their housewarming on Saturday the 25th from 7pm. I'm bringing dessert.
Damian's back went again on Tuesday. He's been told to rest for a fortnight, which means no marathon training, and he's pretty low about it. Give him a call at the weekend.
Deepa just got back from three weeks in Peru and Bolivia. She said the altitude in La Paz floored her for the first two days. Want to hear more about it over coffee soon.
Mihai's sister Rana is visiting from Bucharest next weekend. It's her first time in London, and he's taking her to see Wicked on the Saturday night.
Tendai mentioned that her husband Delroy has been having awful migraines. He's seeing a neurologist on the 30th at 4:15. She's worried it's something serious.
Ethan said Lucy's dad, Uncle Delroy, is retiring at the end of the year after thirty years at the post office. Big party planned for the 20th of December.

Rin's flight to Seoul got cancelled because of the typhoon. She's rebooked for Tuesday night instead, which means she'll miss the first two days with her grandmother. Her grandmother has been unwell since the summer and Rin is worried about her. Her cousin Hiroshi is meeting her at Incheon the next morning.
Felix is cycling from London to Paris in June for charity. Need to sponsor him before the end of the month.
Connor's mum had a minor stroke on Friday. She's stable and in hospital in Belfast, and he's flying over first thing tomorrow. He'll probably stay at least a week. Text him tomorrow evening.
Pick up Julia's present before Thursday. Gift-wrapped if possible.
Krisztina's son Gabriel is doing his Grade 5 piano exam on Saturday morning. He's been practising every night and is very nervous. Ask her how it went afterwards.
Aiko loves anything matcha. She mentioned wanting one of those ceramic whisks for her birthday.
Chris and Joanna are spending New Year in Reykjavik. They're hoping to see the northern lights. Joanna is a bit anxious about the cold because of her asthma.
Hamza is back on crutches after the surgery. Physio twice a week, every Tuesday and Friday at 8 in the morning, for the next two months. He's very fed up.
The dentist rang to move my appointment to Monday the 2nd at 9:40.
Lindiwe's mum, Mrs Olsen, is flying in from Johannesburg on the 15th to help with the baby. She's staying for six weeks.
Gabriel's sister Lucy has a big presentation at work on Thursday afternoon. He said she's been dreading it for weeks. Remind me to send her a quick good luck text that morning.
Femi's dad, Dr Williams, is recovering at home after his heart bypass. Femi says he's grumpy but on the mend, and he's going back to Lagos again in December to see him.

Long call with Aisha tonight. Her husband Chris has been signed off work with stress, and their youngest, Zoe, has had tonsillitis for over a week. On top of that, her mum is having cataract surgery on Wednesday morning and Aisha is the one taking her. She sounded exhausted. I'm going to cook them a lasagne on Tuesday and drop it round. Should check in with her again on Thursday, the day after her mum's operation.
Leon Garcia, or Leo as everyone calls him, has started as a junior doctor at St Thomas'. First night shift was on Friday. Message him to see how it went.
Nasser is coeliac, and his wife Divya hates spicy food. Note for next time we have them over.
Hiroshi sprained his ankle on a hike in Snowdonia last weekend. He's hobbling but says it's not too bad.
Weekend plan: finish packing on Friday evening, airport by 5am Saturday, and check in online the day before.
